queries: (Image:*\\whoami.exe OR OriginalFileName:whoami.exe) AND CommandLine:(*\ \-all* OR *\ \/all* OR *\ –all* OR *\ —all* OR *\ ―all*)

from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (ends_with(Image, "\\whoami.exe") or OriginalFileName=="whoami.exe") and (CommandLine like "* -all*" or CommandLine like "* /all*" or CommandLine like "* –all*" or CommandLine like "* —all*" or CommandLine like "* ―all*")
any where (Image:"*\\whoami.exe" or OriginalFileName:"whoami.exe") and CommandLine like~ ("* -all*", "* /all*", "* –all*", "* —all*", "* ―all*")

(Image endswith "\\whoami.exe" or OriginalFileName =~ "whoami.exe") and (CommandLine contains " -all" or CommandLine contains " /all" or CommandLine contains " –all" or CommandLine contains " —all" or CommandLine contains " ―all")

{job=~"eventlog|winlog|windows|fluentbit.*"} | json | (Image=~`(?i).*\\whoami\.exe$` or OriginalFileName=~`(?i)^whoami\.exe$`) and CommandLine=~`(?i).*\ \-all.*` or CommandLine=~`(?i).*\ /all.*` or CommandLine=~`(?i).*\ –all.*` or CommandLine=~`(?i).*\ —all.*` or CommandLine=~`(?i).*\ ―all.*`
(Image:*\\whoami.exe OR OriginalFileName:whoami.exe) AND CommandLine:(*\ \-all* OR *\ \/all* OR *\ –all* OR *\ —all* OR *\ ―all*)
Image="*\\whoami.exe" OR OriginalFileName="whoami.exe" CommandLine="* -all*" OR CommandLine="* /all*" OR CommandLine="* –all*" OR CommandLine="* —all*" OR CommandLine="* ―all*"

SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Image LIKE '%\\whoami.exe' ESCAPE '\' OR OriginalFileName='whoami.exe') AND (CommandLine LIKE '% -all%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% /all%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% –all%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% —all%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '% ―all%' ESCAPE '\')
